__STUB__
Surfboard tucked under one arm, fin pointing back, wax-scuffed deck visible.
Shaved-ice cone topped with strawberry syrup mid-melt, plastic spoon tucked in cup.
Sand-castle bucket and yellow shovel both gripped in same hand, damp sand clinging.
Disposable yellow waterproof camera held mid-snap toward off-frame friend, eye squinting.
Ukulele held casual across knees, fingers loose on neck, sandy woven strap.
Manga splayed open with sand-grains caught on glossy page, finger marking spot.
Beach-parasol handle gripped high, candy-stripe fabric casting shadow overhead in frame.
Whistle at lips mid-blow, woven cord looped around neck, free hand on hip.
Bluetooth-speaker held aloft, music-icon glowing on small screen, rubber wrist-strap dangling.
Cupped hands cradling pink scallop-shell, fine sand pooling between fingers gently.
Hand-sparkler held away from face mid-spark, gold spray catching warm evening light.
Volleyball spinning on extended fingertip, wrist cocked, ball caught mid-rotation cleanly.
Snorkel mask pushed up on forehead, rubber seal leaving faint pink ring.
Ramune bottle tilted mid-sip, glass marble clinking audibly against the narrow neck.
Small sand-mold fish pressed out onto towel, wet sand holding every fin-detail.
Polaroid photo held at arm's length, image slowly developing in afternoon sun.
Harmonica cupped loosely between both palms, sea breeze carrying faint reed-hum.
Rolled beach-mat tucked under one arm, elastic strap barely holding the bundle.
Starfish balanced carefully on flat open palm, tiny tube-feet still faintly moving.
Sketchbook propped on bent knee, pencil-sketch of distant waves half-finished inside.
Kite-string spool gripped with both hands, line tugging taut toward bright sky.
Festival yo-yo water-balloon pinched between fingers, cool water sloshing inside net.
Fishing rod held loosely at side, line trailing into still shallows below pier.
Paperback novel held open one-handed, corner pages softened and gritty with beach-sand.
